about: Fictional user situations for the 20-story chain test. Each step is what the context unit would observe at that check: gapH is the hours since the previous check, facts are short observations, chat is what the user left in /genpet-chat since the last story, read=failed means the sessions could not be read. The same timelines are used for every group so results can be compared.

facts: 最近三小时的会话都叫「年会演讲 幻灯片」，用户在改第 6 到 12 页，还在继续。
同一个演讲幻灯片的会话一直延续，新会话叫「演讲 讲稿精简」，用户在把讲稿从 15 分钟压到 10 分钟。
凌晨仍有「演讲 讲稿精简」会话，最后一条在 40 分钟前。
上午没有新的非宠物会话；最后一次是凌晨的讲稿会话。
unknowns: 用户是在休息还是离开电脑，不知道

facts: 下午出现「演讲 彩排计时」会话，用户在掐时间排练。
A.chat: 栗灯，我明天就要上台讲了，有点紧张。

facts: 晚上会话「演讲 最后检查」，用户说「就这样吧，不改了」。
深夜到清晨没有新的非宠物会话。
中午出现会话「演讲后 整理听众提问」，用户在记录现场被问到的三个问题，说讲得比预想顺。
下午会话「周末想做的菜」，用户在找一道不太甜的南瓜汤做法。
Codex 开着，但这 5 小时没有新的非宠物会话。
晚上会话「南瓜汤 少放糖」，用户问能不能用椰奶代替淡奶油。
这两天没有任何会话，电脑大部分时间没开；上一次会话是周五晚上。
周日晚上回来，新会话「学一下 Rust 所有权」，用户在看入门教程的第 4 章。
Rust 入门会话继续，用户写了第一个能编译的小练习，说「借用检查器真严格」。
会话「Rust 练习 链表」，用户卡在可变借用上，换了三种写法。
A.chat: 那碗南瓜汤我真的做了，椰奶版很好喝。

facts: 深夜会话「Rust 练习 链表」还在继续，最后一条在 20 分钟前。
上午会话标题「链表终于过了」，用户说用 Option 和 take 解决了。
下午会话「下个月去青岛 行程」，用户在查海边的住处。
晚上会话「青岛 行程」继续，用户订好了周六的车票。
The last three hours of sessions are titled "release 2.4 checklist"; the user is closing the final issues before Friday's release.
A new session "flaky e2e test on checkout" continues the release work; the user has rerun the same test many times.
Late-night session "flaky e2e test on checkout" is still going; the last message was 30 minutes ago.
Morning session "found it: race in cart timer"; the user fixed the flaky test.
Afternoon session "release 2.4 notes"; the user is writing release notes for users.
Evening session "release 2.4 shipped"; the user said the release is out.
No new non-pet sessions overnight.
Codex is open but there are no new non-pet sessions in these 5 hours.
Session "docs: theming guide"; the user is writing a guide on dark mode colors.
Session "docs: theming guide" continues; the user is choosing screenshots.
Session "weekend: build a small playlist app?"; the user is sketching an idea for a side project.
No sessions for two days; the computer was mostly off. The last session was Friday evening.
Sunday night, new session "playlist app: pick a stack"; the user is comparing two frameworks.
Session "playlist app: first screen"; the user got a list of songs to render.
Session "playlist app: drag to reorder"; the user is stuck on drag and drop.
B.chat: Do you ever get bored waiting for me?

facts: Late-night session "playlist app: drag to reorder" still going; last message 15 minutes ago.
Morning session "reorder works!"; the user got drag and drop working.
Session "team offsite next week"; the user is planning a talk for the team offsite.
Codex is open but there are no new non-pet sessions in these 5 hours.

深夜到清晨没有新的非宠物会话。
中午会话「新家 网络」，用户说已经搬进新家，正在等宽带上门。
C.chat: 麦麦，新家阳台很小，但花放得下。

facts: 会话「新家 拆箱」，用户在拆厨房的箱子，找不到开瓶器。
会话「新家 书桌放哪」，用户在比较靠窗还是靠墙。

facts: 深夜没有新的非宠物会话。
上午会话「邀请朋友来新家吃饭」，用户在想菜单。
